question.text: What is the minimum net worth requirement for an applicant seeking registration as a KYC Registration Agency (KRA) with SEBI?

answer.text: At least Rs. 50 crores on a continuous basis
At least Rs. 10 crores on a continuous basis
At least Rs. 5 crores on a continuous basis
At least Rs. 25 crores on a continuous basis

explanation.text: The Logic: As per SEBI (KYC Registration Agency) Regulations, 2011, the applicant should have a net worth of at least Rs. 25 crores on a continuous basis to be eligible for registration as a KRA. The Trap: Candidates may confuse this with net worth requirements of other intermediaries like stock brokers or merchant bankers. Note: Beyond the Rs. 25 crores net-worth requirement, the applicant must separately satisfy SEBI on its organizational capabilities, technology systems, and data-privacy safeguards.
